unparsed.answer: The study does not support the hypothesis that reperfusion is required before the index ischemia.
Routine intraoperative frozen-section examination is not universally worthwhile. Its benefit is greatest in larger tumors and in SLNs with substantial metastatic disease.
The study supports the presence of pyloric mucosal hypertrophy in infants with hypertrophic pyloric stenosis, but it does not establish that this hypertrophy is the cause of the disease.
Admission to a tertiary center does not improve survival in patients with cardiogenic shock complicating acute myocardial infarction.
The study does not support the hypothesis that birth center care during a woman's first pregnancy affects her future reproduction.
The study does not establish that single-agent mitoxantrone is as effective as combination chemotherapy.
Double reading of barium enemas is not necessary for routine practice.
Delayed facial palsy after stapedectomy may be prevented by preventing recurrent herpes labialis, although the study did not establish that HSV-1 infection alone causes delayed facial palsy.
The study does not establish that an early adopter exists, but it supports the hypothesis that early adoption of drugs is not a personal trait independent of drug groups.
Aspiration of ethanol-mixed fluid is not advantageous for treatment of benign cystic thyroid nodules.
Frequent fast-food consumption is associated with a higher risk of wheeze and current wheeze, but it is not established as a risk factor for asthma.
The study does not support a general influence of surgeon experience on TURP outcomes.

Somatostatin can confer insulinostatic effects of neuromedin U in the rat pancreas, but the study does not establish that somatostatin is the principal mediator of neuromedin U's effects in intact tissue.

The study supports an association between atopic dermatitis and a history of impetigo, but it does not establish that lifetime prevalence of molluscum or herpes infection is increased in children with atopic dermatitis.
The study does not support the conclusion that epidural analgesia is a risky technique.
The study supports an association between human cytomegalovirus infection and hypertension, but this association is not established after adjustment for age.
The study does not support the hypothesis that music reduces stress in mechanically ventilated patients.

CPAP therapy may improve quality of life in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and obstructive sleep apnea, but the evidence is limited by the study's small sample size and the lack of statistically significant improvement in other measured sleep and quality-of-life parameters.
Mental imagery fMRI can identify patients with disorders of consciousness who may recover, but it is not a reliable predictor of recovery.

The study supports that a more frequent skin-care protocol may reduce the incidence of moderate incontinence-associated dermatitis, but it does not support that it reduces the severity of the dermatitis.
The study does not establish acupuncture as an effective treatment for phonotraumatic vocal pathologies.

The study supports the feasibility and acceptability of intravenous opioid patient-controlled therapy for breathlessness in patients with advanced disease. It also supports the reduction of breathlessness with this mode of administration.
Comorbidity may lead to poorer depression outcomes, but the study does not establish a statistically significant association.
The ACE gene is a candidate for insulin resistance, but the study does not establish that the insertion allele is a causal candidate.
The study supports the possibility of a hormonal influence on anal continence, although it does not establish that this influence is the primary cause of incontinence.
Abscesses, phlegmons, and recurrent disease are not absolute contraindications to laparoscopic-assisted ileocolic resection for Crohn's disease.
Not necessarily. Stage I non-small cell lung cancer had a 5-year survival of 63%, but tumor size, histology, and margin status were important prognostic factors.

limitations: Subgroups are exploratory, only 25 questions per knowledge subject.
Permutation p-values are conditional on current trained adapters and judge scores; no training-seed uncertainty.
Literal context labels only check explicit Yes/No/Maybe starts, not all semantic answers or reference validity.

reference_loss_verification.interpretation: Answer-token NLL is conditioned on the gold rationale. It does not independently measure closed-book factual knowledge.
